deadline.value: Apply before Monday 18 January for full consideration for EPSRC or University of Bristol funding (so by 17 January 2027).
deadline.quote: To receive full consideration for EPSRC or University of Bristol funding, applications should be submitted before Monday 18 January.

supervisor.value: You are encouraged to name Bristol academics you would consider as supervisors in your research statement.
supervisor.quote: We encourage you to specify the Bristol academics you would consider as potential supervisors.

funding.value: EPSRC and University funding is competitive and overseas students are encouraged to seek funding from their own countries.
funding.quote: As these funded opportunities are competitive, we encourage overseas students to seek funding from their own countries as well.

entry_route.value: A first or upper-second honours degree in mathematics or a closely related subject, or a relevant master's; school-funded places may need higher grades.
entry_route.quote: A first-class or upper second-class honours degree (or international equivalent) in mathematics or a closely related subject, or a relevant master's qualification. Places funded by the school may be subject to higher entry requirements.

toefl_min.value: English profile F. TOEFL iBT tests from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills (older tests: 83 overall).
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level F.
